messages:
sarah: noticing a gap — incidentbot didn't page for the pagerflow webhook errors about 15:12 UTC, channel stayed quiet. anyone seeing paging failures? cc @oncall-ryan

devops-bot: automated: /integrations/pagerflow POST 503 x 120 attempts in 3m, backoff triggered, fallback routing suppressed due to rate_window

jordan: saw a spike in 5xx from pagerflow-proxy around 15:11. looks like the rotator deploy touched the signing proxy? :eyes:

mike: oncall — pulling logs now. redis TTLs look fine. getting auth errors from rotator when trying to sign webhook payloads.

incidentbot: incidentbot: attempted to page group "infra-oncall" but response code 429 from paging gateway, page suppressed by rate-limiter policy.

olivia: support just flagged a customer ticket — missed page to oncall, caused a 12m delay for a production incident. ticket #INC-12345, priority P2.

sarah: OK manual mitigation — matt can you call the primary oncall and escalate? I'll flip the fallback routing to the phone fallback for the next 30m.

matt: calling Ryan now. also reverting the rotator signing change to the previous image to test if that clears 5xx.

oncall-ryan: answered phone. confirming I got the manual page. triaging the customer report now. thanks for the ping.

jordan: paste of test curl I'm running to reproduce webhook signing error:
```
curl -v -X POST https://pagerflow.internal/v1/webhook -H "X-Signature: sha256=..." -d '{"alert":"test"}'
# response: 503 "signature validation failed"
```

mike: stack trace snippet from rotator logs shows HMAC key lookup returning 404 for kms://rotator/keys/pagerflow-signing-key — looks like key rotation didn't publish new alias.

olivia: logging customer impact: 3 customers in EU saw delayed pages, one opened support chat and escalated. recording for post-incident follow-up.

sarah: temporary playbook steps posted to #eng-oncall: manual paging instructions, phone fallback enabled, and incidentbot rate-window lowered to avoid suppression for critical groups.

matt: rollback in progress (deployed previous rotator image). will monitor for 10m, then re-enable incidentbot routing.

devops-bot: automated: rotator-deploy rollback started by matt at 15:22 UTC, rollout status: 1/3 pods updated, checking health probes.

jordan: verifying webhooks now — test curl returns 200, signature validation OK.

mike: confirmed redis and gateway metrics back to normal, no more 5xx from pagerflow-proxy.

incidentbot: incidentbot: pages resumed for group "infra-oncall" at 15:31 UTC. no additional suppressed pages in last 9m.

olivia: updated support ticket #INC-12345 with mitigation steps and ETA for postmortem. customer notified about delay and that paging is restored.

sarah: postmortem owners: jordan (root cause), matt (deploy/process), olivia (customer comms). action items: 1) Add key-rotation integration test for pagerflow-signing-key, 2) adjust incidentbot rate-window to allow emergency override, 3) docs for manual phone fallback.

matt: noted. will open follow-up RFC and link to this thread.

jordan: quick note — we should add a synthetic that triggers a low-volume page and verifies oncall ack within 30s after any signing/key rotation deploys.

sarah: agree. closing live mitigation. set P1->P2 severity to reflect customer impact and moving to post-incident review. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
